name: po-o12
prompt:
In server/src/overview.rs, replace the body `todo!("unit o12")` of fn progress_part with the real code. Keep its signature and doc comment exactly. Spec: map sqlx errors to Err(e.to_string()) with `?`.
1. Rows: `SELECT id, COALESCE(parent_id, ''), kind, title, state FROM tasks WHERE project_id = ? AND user_id = ? ORDER BY position, rowid` as Vec<(String, String, String, String, String)>, mapped into TaskRow { id, parent_id, kind, title, state }.
2. Deps: `SELECT d.task_id, d.depends_on FROM task_deps d JOIN tasks t ON t.id = d.task_id WHERE t.project_id = ? AND t.user_id = ?` as Vec<(String, String)>.
3. let mut out = progress(&rows, &deps);
4. Last merged PR: `SELECT t.title, e.detail FROM task_events e JOIN tasks t ON t.id = e.task_id WHERE t.project_id = ? AND t.user_id = ? AND e.kind = 'forge' ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT 20` as Vec<(String, String)>; the first whose detail parses as JSON with v["state"]["to"] == "done" gives json!({ "title": title, "pr": v["pr"].as_str().unwrap_or("") }). Set out["lastMerged"] to it, or Value::Null when there is none.
Return Ok(out).
Change nothing else in the file; the other functions keep their todo!() until their own job.
